## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Give the checks run and their results. For gameplay claims, include the matching build, hardware, settings, route and cache state. State remaining limits; fixture/source checks do not establish actual gameplay or production update delivery.

## Source and resources

For imported code or changed resources, link the source revision, license and provenance. Run the publication guard before pushing. Keep private game content, generated shaders, saves, logs and credentials outside the PR.
